collectly_payment_method_id.description: Collectly payment method ID which you can obtain from "/payment-methods" endpoint

installment.description: Amount to charge every week/2nd week/month according to period_type.

location_id.description: This field determines where to route funds for pre-service payment plans in case multiple bank accounts are connected. Should be empty in other cases.

n_installments.description: The total count of planned payments for this payment plan.

next_payment_date.description: datetime of the next planned charge

payments_made.description: The count of already charged payments for this payment plan.

start_date.description: ISO-8601 date format. The date when the first installment will be charged. Must not be in the past. Successive installment dates are computed according to the "period_type". Convert the start date to UTC timezone.

status.description: Current status of the payment plan

total_amount.description: Total amount to be charged on the payment plan.It is always equal to patient balance at payment plan subscription momentfor the "standard" type.

type.description: "standard" - post-service payment plan, "upfront" - pre-service payment plan
